watches.name: H1 - NEON HONG KONG
watches.description: Exclusive Edition for Authorised Retailers and only available for purchase in Watch Fair. Windup San Francisco Windup New York City Spring Sprung Sprang When people think of Hong Kong’s history and heritage, common imagery often comes to mind — the iconic skyline, traditional junk boats, and the fusion of East and West. While these visuals reflect how outsiders may see Hong Kong, they don’t fully capture the heart and soul of our home. For this Hong Kong Limited Edition, we drew inspiration from one of the city’s nostalgic elements — the Vintage Begonia glass (海棠玻璃), once a familiar sight in old Hong Kong. Known for its delicate craftsmanship and timeless beauty, this glass design reflects the subtle elegance of a bygone era. We’ve reimagined this aesthetic on the watch dial, allowing light and shadow to dance across its surface, much like the way it once adorned countless homes across the city. H1 Exclusive Edition stay in the series of good, celebrating one of the city's most famous views. The striking Purple Mother of Pearl dial captures the magic of evening time, When the sun sets, the Hong Kong skyline reflects a deep, shifting purple colour onto the fading sky. This signature dusk scene is perhaps the most iconic modern image of the city.

watches.name: P2 - Natural Tiger Eye Stone with Lab-grown Diamonds
watches.description: REF: MB3R0-P2 The Trinova elevates the neo-vintage story through the raw elegance of Natural Tiger Eye. Its shimmering, golden-brown dial provides a soulful contrast to the crisp geometry of four triangular DVS1 lab-grown diamonds. It’s a piece of quiet opulence that marries the warmth of the earth with the brilliance of modern innovation. Each lab-grown diamond is meticulously set directly into the tiger eye stone, with its pointed base anchored within the stone and rhodium-plated for added brilliance. A semi-glossy black crocodile-pattern Italian leather strap completes this striking timepiece, a true jewel of geometry and light. watches.name: Hoi Tong Hong Kong Limited Edition II
watches.description: Limited 200 pieces A few months ago, we introduced Monbrey’s special Hong Kong limited edition watch, inspired by one of the city’s most nostalgic elements — Hoi Tong glass, once a familiar sight across old Hong Kong 🇭🇰 The first edition sold out within just a few days. We heard from many of you who missed out, so we’re excited to announce the release of Version 2.0. This new design draws from an even more vintage aesthetic than the original. When people think of Hong Kong’s history and heritage, common imagery often comes to mind — the iconic skyline, traditional junk boats, and the fusion of East and West. While these visuals reflect how outsiders may see Hong Kong, they don’t fully capture the heart and soul of our home. For this Hong Kong Limited Edition, we drew inspiration from one of the city’s nostalgic elements — the Vintage Begonia glass (海棠玻璃), once a familiar sight in old Hong Kong. Known for its delicate craftsmanship and timeless beauty, this glass design reflects the subtle elegance of a bygone era. We’ve reimagined this aesthetic on the watch dial, allowing light and shadow to dance across its surface, much like the way it once adorned countless homes across the city. With this model, we've achieved something rare: a truly Made-in-Hong Kong leather strap. This means the leather isn't just crafted here-it's sourced from the Sheung Shui Slaughterhouse and fully tanned in the city at the Shui Hing Tannery Factory. Shui Hing is Hong Kong's only remaining tannery. Founded in 1985, they carry on a century-old local industry that is quicky disappearing. Because local demand is so low nowadays, they only process the leather from the slaughterhouse once or twice a year. This makes out strap an incredibly rare item, tied directly to the rhythm of local Hong Kong production.

watches.name: L11 - TWO TONE (Anniversary edition)
watches.description: Introducing our exclusive 1st Year Anniversary Special Edition! Celebrate a year of excellence with our special release! We are thrilled to present our 1st Year Anniversary Special Edition, crafted with captivating two-tone details and packed with a black enamel dial that will elevate the vintage experience to new heights. MB1 - our first series inspired by the '70s wedge era car design movement. The wedge era in car design was characterized by a distinctive angular aesthetic. This angular aesthetic, reminiscent of iconic cars like the DMC DeLorean, Lamborghini Countach, and Aston Martin Bulldog, is brought to life in MB1. It's designed as if it came from the 1970s but in another dimension; with its classic size, multi-faceted details, and intriguing design similarity came across the past and the future. L11 comes with a Black enamel-coated dial The case is made of 316L stainless steel with a distinct finish, featuring angular lugs and a side profile. Achieving exceptional magnetic resistance of up to 4800 A/m, the calibre is enclosed in a Faraday cage. MB1 is a tribute to an era that continues to inspire and captivate.
